question: Using the grand average of hydropathicity (GRAVY) score and the formula solubility = 1 / (1 + exp(2 * GRAVY)), predict the solubility of the protein sequence below. Suggest the top 3 single-point mutations that most improve solubility by substituting hydrophobic residues with hydrophilic ones. Report the original solubility, the top 3 mutations with solubility gain, and the best mutant sequence and solubility. Sequence: MQIFVKTLTGKTITLEVEPSDTIENVKAKIQDKEGIPPDQQRLIFAGKQLEDGRTLSDYNIQKESTLHLVLRLRGG

expected_output.description: labeled values: original sequence, original solubility, best mutant sequence, best mutant solubility
rows as mutations, columns should include position, original, mutant, solubility_gain
